$comment: requires_bootstrap is the highest call shape this plugin needs. Every ledger transition records an execution event through bootstrap_lib.execution_event -- make_event(..., schema=) with plugins-kit.execution-event/v1 for every event and plugins-kit.execution-event/v2 for the interrupt event (SUPPORTED_SCHEMAS must hold both), usage_payload, utc_timestamp, validate_stream, and JsonlSink(path, mode='create') for `job-kit events --out` -- a call shape first shipped in bootstrap 0.136.0; job-kit also validates model declarations with bootstrap_lib.model_declaration.parse (bootstrap 0.129.0). Interrupt requests and resolutions are checked by bootstrap_lib.interrupt_contract (SUPPORTED_CONTRACTS must hold plugins-kit.interrupt-contract/v1; check_request, parse_request_document, validate_input, decision_outcome, same_resolution, expiry, bound_reason and resolution_document with the keyword shapes job_kit.interrupts binds), first shipped in bootstrap 0.137.0. The contract validates through llm_scripting_kit.completion.json_schema under the frozen subset selector (SUPPORTED_SUBSETS, check_schema(schema, subset=), validate(schema, value, subset=)), first shipped in llm-scripting-kit 0.56.0, which is the first floor of the llm-scripting-kit entry below; job-kit also imports llm_scripting_kit.completion.requirements.arm_call and passes HaltError(retry_after_s=...) through its backpressure wait, both first shipped in llm-scripting-kit 0.61.0 and probed by job_kit.select, which is the current min_version.
